text: Today I will show you the fastest way to plan a week of content.
Before we begin, let me explain how I discovered this workflow and why my old process never worked.
First, capture every idea in one place and score it by audience intent.
Then group related ideas into a sequence so each upload naturally creates demand for the next.
The scoring step is where this becomes useful: evidence replaces the blank page.
Finally, review the plan, keep the strongest hook, and schedule the week.
